title: Clients
subtitle: Customers migrated from the previous system, most with only a name. The figures show what still needs filling in; open a row to see its record, edit it, or archive it.
editSubtitle: Fill in the details the previous system never recorded. Blank fields stay blank rather than being stored as empty text.
newSubtitle: Only the name is required, and it is checked against the book as you type. The preview on the right is the record the list will show.

archiveDialog.title: Archive client?
archiveDialog.body: {name} will be hidden from the default list and from future pickers. Nothing is deleted — its history stays intact and you can restore it at any time.

restoreDialog.title: Restore client?
restoreDialog.body: {name} will appear in the list again.

form.name: Client name
form.contactMeta: Optional, but this is what the list is missing
form.blankHint: Leave a field blank rather than guessing — blanks are counted and can be chased later.
form.reachableNote: This client will count as reachable.
form.unreachableNote: Blank fields stay blank. This client will show up under “Needs contact” until an email or phone is added.
